title: Binary division step
statement:
Represent a state $S$ by nested pair encodings, with outer first component $a$, and outer second component encoding a triple $(d,R,q)$; write $d=[h]\mathbin{+
egthinspace+}t$, where $h$ is its first Boolean digit, taken to be false if $d$ is empty. If $d$ is empty, leave $S$ unchanged. Otherwise compare $a$ with the binary number represented by $[h]\mathbin{+
egthinspace+}R$. If $a$ is no greater, return the nested encoding with components $a$, $t$, the binary subtraction of $[h]\mathbin{+
egthinspace+}R$ by $a$, and the digit true prepended to $q$; if $a$ is greater, return the encoding with components $a$, $t$, the unchanged $[h]\mathbin{+
egthinspace+}R$, and the digit false prepended to $q$.
caveat: The pairing and decoding conventions, binary comparison, and binary subtraction are referenced but not defined in the supplied context.
